Adjusted view: While the FOMC statement is modestly positive on growth and labor markets, the Financial Stability Report flags persistent vulnerabilities—elevated valuation pressures, pressure on credit quality (notably from office CRE vacancy rates), money market fund structural funding risks, leveraged Treasury basis trades, and uncertainty tied to interest rate volatility, public debt, and geopolitics. These factors temper optimism and justify a slightly less positive sentiment than before.
